scenarios.name: Continue a modeling command after switching ribbon tabs

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part containing a solid block is active in the MCAD Software
the ribbon is minimized to tabs
the user selects the 3D Model tab and opens Shell from the Modify group
the Shell properties panel and model preview appear
the user selects the Tools ribbon tab
temporary Tools command groups appear beneath the tabs
the Shell properties panel and model preview remain visible
the Shell properties panel and preview close
the original solid block remains visible
the ribbon remains minimized to tabs with Tools selected
